img.caption: Fig 3: Calibration quality and refusal behavior. Left: Expected Calibration Error (15-bin, lower is better); right: intra-domain false-reject rate. QP-OneModel over-refuses 86% of in-domain CLINC150 queries; MULACONF rejects 100% of MixATIS and 82% of MixSNIPS in-domain queries. CICC and MULACONF are moderately miscalibrated on CLINC150 (ECE 0.16). Ours attains the lowest ECE on CLINC150 (0.005) and MixSNIPS (0.045) while keeping false refusal bounded at 4.6-20.8%.
